days.label: Day 1
days.title: Etruria to Trentham
days.summary: Pick up the boat and cruise a short first leg — no rush on day one.

stops.name: Festival Park Marina, Etruria
stops.subtitle: Premise
stops.note: Pick up Duchess 2 Royal (booking 74782). Induction ~2:30–3:30pm, on the water by ~4pm.

stops.name: Trentham Estate
stops.subtitle: Gardens & lake
stops.note: Canalside gardens and lake — good first-evening mooring, no rush getting here.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Barlaston to Stone
days.summary: Work through the lock flight, pass the Wedgwood factory, overnight in Stone.

stops.name: Depart Trentham
stops.subtitle: Start of day
stops.note: Leave the overnight mooring, heading south.

stops.name: World of Wedgwood, Barlaston
stops.subtitle: Factory, museum & tea room
stops.note: Canalside — worth a mooring stop as you pass through the lock flight.

stops.name: Stone town moorings
stops.subtitle: Pubs & shops on the water
stops.note: Overnight in Stone. Likely busier than usual — other Caldon-displaced boats redirected this way too.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Tixall Wide & Great Haywood
days.summary: No-lock cruising to a broad, scenic pool, then moor near Shugborough.

stops.name: Depart Stone
stops.subtitle: Start of day
stops.note: Leave the overnight mooring, continuing south.

stops.name: Tixall Wide
stops.subtitle: Broad, lake-like stretch
stops.note: No locks. One of the most photographed mooring spots on the network — arrive early for a good spot.

stops.name: Shugborough Hall / Great Haywood
stops.subtitle: Estate & village
stops.note: Also the suggested jump-off point for an Alton Towers taxi (~40 min) if wanted.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Return leg toward Stone
days.summary: Retrace north, back toward the marina end of the route.

stops.name: Depart Great Haywood
stops.subtitle: Start of day
stops.note: Leave the overnight mooring, heading north.

stops.name: Stone town moorings
stops.subtitle: Overnight (return)
stops.note: Overnight around Stone or Barlaston depending on pace.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Back to base
days.summary: Short final cruise back into Etruria to return the boat.

stops.name: Depart Stone
stops.subtitle: Start of day
stops.note: Final short cruise back to base.

stops.name: Festival Park Marina, Etruria
stops.subtitle: End of trip
stops.note: Return the boat by the required morning time.
